purpose: Distinguish OS CPU/page faults from Go GC accounting on A, and retain portable-client boundaries missing from B's 125ms tail. This is diagnostic coverage, not a claimed latency/root-cause fix.

runtime.fields: OS process CPU delta, page-fault delta, Windows processor-group busy/total deltas; explicit known flags. Unknown, counter rollback/wrap and overflow do not become measured zero.
runtime.readTiming: Runtime-metrics and OS-counter read envelopes are separate. A 100ms OS read can trigger os_read_slow without being mislabeled as metrics_read_slow.
runtime.limits: Existing 64-sample ring and independent 8-record failure/nonfatal budgets remain. Sampler-side only; no native input/heartbeat work, stack trace, extra input or recovery action.
runtime.interpretation: Adjacent sequential API observations, not atomic measurements of an exact GC pause. OS CPU is not Go's processor-summed GC CPU accounting. Page faults include soft faults; processor-group CPU is not every group on >64-CPU hosts.
runtime.benchmark: Repeated OS/full-sampler benchmarks: approximately 0.285-0.448ms/op, 152B and 5 allocations/op on A. Initial full-sampler benchmark averaged 3.932ms/op. These are observed wall-time costs, not CPU utilization or production upper bounds.

parentPhases: matched decode to portable-client completion before deferred unlock/cancel
nativeIPC.parentPresence: parentMeasured distinguishes measured zero from unavailable timing; parentMicros contains only three durations.
nativeIPC.budget: Core and disjoint parent durations share the existing 120s observation bound. Invalid timing drops optional evidence without changing input outcomes.
nativeIPC.wire: Fixed suffix 32 -> 44 bytes, 12 additional bytes per profiled local ACK. Native images are rebuilt and hash-matched together; no extra input submission, read/write operation or round trip.
nativeIPC.cancellation: A failed/unconfirmed ExchangeInput return cannot inspect or publish the callback-owned profile. Parent completion is finalized synchronously only after matching confirmed exchange.
nativeIPC.limits: Does not observe time before portable-client entry or deferred unlock/cancel. Mutex-acquisition elapsed time does not prove lock contention. No subtraction from child apply to invent scheduler duration.

codecBenchmark.scope: One ACK encode/decode, 100ms per variant; detailed variant includes parent spans. Excludes real pipes, QPC reads, Windows scheduling, OS sampler and native input.

validation: Full handoff/inputworker/productlog/residentagent tests; selected native IPC and canceled-admission race tests with local LLVM; timestamp/presence/budget, real-QPC post-decode delay, next-ACK alignment, unknown OS counters, max-size GC export, sanitizer round trips and go vet/diff checks passed.
unchanged: Input authority, ordering, cancellation outcomes, lease/heartbeat deadlines and retries. No DB, external API or runner change. Public runtime flight recording remains off.
deployment: Installation and actual physical observations recorded separately. No push/public release requested.
